comment_regular: Converts an Oblivion/Gamebryo NiPixelFormat into D3DFORMAT. Honors an explicit format at +0x0C; otherwise maps channel masks, bit depth, compressed DXT1/3/5, float, luminance, palette, and depth/stencil layouts. Returns D3DFMT_UNKNOWN for unsupported layouts.
